about_the_game:
Amaya and Will wake up in an abandoned orphanage, trapped in a place where innocence shatters and memories turn into threats. Among forgotten rooms and endless hallways, they will discover that not everything hidden is asleep… Some shadows wait patiently to strike.

A Third-Person Horror Adventure

This linear 3D survival horror immerses you in an unsettling atmosphere, where exploration and puzzle-solving are key to progress. Every corner of the orphanage is designed to evoke both fascination and fear, blending the sinister with the poetically beautiful.

Two Protagonists, Two Perspectives

The story unfolds through Amaya and Will, whom you will control at different moments to experience their unique points of view. Each carries personal motivations and emotions, allowing you to discover the orphanage from different angles and deepen the game’s emotional narrative.

Mysteries Waiting to Be Solved

Ancient locks, hidden mechanisms, and clever puzzles will turn your wits into your best survival tool. Solving them will open not only physical doors but also narrative ones, revealing the secrets surrounding the orphanage.

A Dark and Immersive Aesthetic

The environments and characters are crafted with a unique visual style: strange proportions, symbol-laden atmospheres, and a disturbing beauty that blends the dreamlike with the macabre. Every artistic detail is designed to captivate and immerse you even further in this strange and evocative world.

  • A linear experience of psychological and emotional horror.

  • The ability to play from the perspectives of two protagonists with different motivations.

  • Exploration and puzzles seamlessly integrated into the narrative.

  • A dark, fantastical, and disturbing visual style that combines innocence with the macabre.

  • An orphanage full of secrets that are gradually revealed, maintaining tension until the end.

Dare to explore a place where childhood memories turn into nightmares, and where survival means looking beyond the darkness… Even when the darkness stares back at you.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7400 o AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 / AMD RX 560
  • Storage: 8 GB available space

short_description: Play as Amaya and Will, navigating a forsaken orphanage where secrets lurk in the dark. Solve puzzles, uncover hidden truths, and survive a psychological horror tale where innocence twists into nightmare and shadows patiently wait to strike.

Spanish - Latin America*
